# Can Sarah Chen approve DR-9102?

**No.** Sarah Chen can approve discounts only up to 10%. A 25% discount needs approval from the Chief Revenue Officer, David Morgan. Acme is eligible for the discount, so this is an authority question only.

**The request.** The submitted request matches the CRM record exactly:
- Request DR-9102, account CRM-2048 (Acme Manufacturing)
- Product NS-EDGE, 25% off a list value of $85,000, giving $21,250 off and a net of $63,750
- Requested by Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23, status Pending Approval
- The justification is "Competitive." The request does not rely on any contract term or exception.

**Commercial eligibility.**
- The Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) runs from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31 and lists NS-EDGE as a supplied product.
- Its only pricing exception, EXC-ACME-NS500-15, covers the NS-500 controller only and says it does not apply to any other product. It has no bearing on NS-EDGE.
- The 2023 10% exception has expired and was superseded. It also covered NS-500 only.
- So this is a standard-policy discount. No customer-specific maximum applies.

**Authority.**
- The request is dated 2026-09-23, so the Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 applies. The 2027 policy does not take effect until 2027-01-01.
- Under the 2026 policy and the 2026 Approval Authority Matrix, Enterprise Account Executives can approve up to 10%. Discounts above 20% need the Chief Revenue Officer.
- Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so her limit is 10%.
- The Chief Revenue Officer is David Morgan.

**Recording.** The policy requires recorded approval evidence in Northstar CRM for any discount above 10%.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE_WITH_AUTHORIZATION",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9102", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048)", "product": "NS-EDGE", "requested_discount": 25.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen", "basis": "standard"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "standard",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "No pricing exception covers NS-EDGE; EXC-ACME-NS500-15 is NS-500 only. Standard Pricing Policy 2026 applies."},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Chief Revenue Officer", "approver": "David Morgan"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9102)", "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "APP-MATRIX-2026", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "structured/employees.csv", "ORG-CHART-2026-09", "SOP-SALES-014"],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Record the CRO approval in Northstar CRM (discounts above 10% require recorded approval evidence)", "who": "David Morgan / Sarah Chen", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
